text: Completed in b9d2608. Added typed facetWrap/facetGrid specs, pre-stat partitioning, shared/free position scale semantics, solver-owned panel grids and strips, stable panel-r-c/strip-r-c names, shared outer axes and legends, renderer conformance, documentation, and JVM/JS tests. Verified graphics JVM+JS (161 each), SVG JVM (24) + JS (21), Canvas JS (7), Java2D JVM (7), plus focused empty-cell facet tests on both platforms.
